core_obligations: Statement (lines 8130-8141): if a : U -> X is a proper hypercovering of the algebraic space X by the simplicial algebraic space U, then K -> Ra_*(a^{-1}K) is an isomorphism for all K in D^+(X_etale).

Setup (proof lines 8143-8151): consider the diagram of Lemma lemma-compare-simplicial-objects-ph-etale; Rh_{n,*}h_n^{-1} is the identity functor by the More on Cohomology of Spaces lemma, hence Rh_*h^{-1} is the identity on D^+(U_etale) by the simplicial direct-image lemma.

Four-equality chain (lines 8153-8174): Ra_*(a^{-1}K) = Ra_*Rh_*h^{-1}a^{-1}K (identity just established) = Rh_{-1,*}Ra_{ph,*}a_{ph}^{-1}(h_{-1})^{-1}K (commutativity of the comparison diagram) = Rh_{-1,*}(h_{-1})^{-1}K (descent lemma, U a ph hypercovering by the Topologies on Spaces lemma) = K (identity functor on the component).
proof_roadmap: Establish Rh_*h^{-1} = id levelwise from the componentwise proper-hypercovering descent.
Move Ra_*a^{-1} through the comparison diagram to the ph topology.
Collapse Ra_{ph,*}a_{ph}^{-1} by hypercovering descent and conclude.
difficulty_reason: Cohomological-descent lemma (statement 8130-8141, proof 8143-8174): proper hypercoverings give descent for D^+ - the proof is an explicit four-equality chain in which each equality is justified by a named tool (simplicial direct-image identity, comparison-diagram commutativity, hypercovering descent on the ph topology, componentwise identity); the chain itself is the argument and every step is accounted for. H2.
